task.description: Independently re-verified ELIXIR-DEV's REQ-241 claims against git-show'd blobs, not the handoff paraphrase. Read the full diff main...feature/WF02-REQ241-20260905 end to end: every changed line is inside a @doc/@moduledoc heredoc or a '#' comment; defmodule/end counts unchanged per file (identity.ex 1/110, group.ex 1/7, instances.ex 1/44, tasks.ex 1/40, tenant_provisioning.ex 1/26, audit.ex 1/23, all identical before/after). No @spec, function signature, or logic line touched. Spot-checked 7 rewritten sentences against the actual code bodies: (1) identity.ex token-name-from-hash claim ('needs no separate collision check, exposes none of the plaintext's unhashed bytes') corroborated by create_token's own step 4-6 doc and insert_token's SHA-256 hex digest; (2) identity.ex assign/reassign precondition claims ('two concurrent assigns can't silently overwrite each other's effect' / 'distinguishing a reassign from a first-time assign') corroborated by tasks.ex assign_task/4 and reassign_task/4's Multi.run apply clauses pattern-matching assignee_ref nil vs not-nil; (3) tenant_provisioning.ex idempotent-retried-onboarding framing corroborated by provision_tenant_schema/1 returning {:ok, existing} unchanged on a repeat call; (4) identity.ex upsert savepoint-avoidance claim ('would abort the surrounding transaction on the unique-constraint violation unless caught behind an explicit savepoint') corroborated by upsert_by_external_identity/insert_or_fetch's actual select-first + on_conflict: :nothing + re-select shape, never a rescue-based insert; (5) audit.ex verify_chain/2 recompute-vs-linkage-only contrast preserved verbatim in technical substance across all 3 edited spots (moduledoc x2, @doc), only 'R-Co's own'/'R-Co's check' reworded to 'that prior chain-verification function'/'a linkage-only check' -- no change to which check is claimed to run or what it catches; (6) instances.ex 'not hand-duplicated as a separate list needing its own upkeep' accurately restates the prior 'not hand-duplicated for R-Co parity' reasoning (source-of-truth-is-the-schema point unchanged); (7) tasks.ex cursor-collapse rationale ('a cursor is opaque to callers, so there's no caller-actionable difference') accurately describes decode_list_cursor/1's existing :invalid_base64/:invalid_cursor collapse. All 7 state real technical reasons grounded in the code, none invented. Confirmed no scope creep: diff touches exactly the 6 named files plus 2 handoff JSONs (step-00, step-02) -- git diff --stat verified. Confirmed test/letflow/audit_test.exs (flagged by ELIXIR-DEV as containing its own R-Co mentions, out of REQ-241's file list) shows an empty diff -- genuinely untouched. Confirmed TEST-DESIGNER routing: SKIP is correct, matching REQ-232/233/234/235/240 precedent (pure comment/moduledoc change; ORCH already verified mix compile/format/test clean with 249/249 passing, unaffected by prose-only edits). Confirmed SECURITY-REVIEWER sign-off not needed despite identity.ex/tenant_provisioning.ex/audit.ex sitting near tenant-data paths: every changed line is inside a comment or doc heredoc; no permission check, tenant-scoping query, cryptographic verification logic, or auth decision line was altered -- gave audit.ex's verify_chain/2 extra scrutiny specifically and confirmed the recompute-then-compare-linkage algorithm description is unchanged in substance, only the R-Co-attribution phrasing was swapped out.
